rules.title: How to play
rules.r1: Press the ball and pull back: the arrow shows direction and power. Pull further for a faster, higher shot.
rules.r2: Slide your finger or mouse sideways as you release: the ball curls that way and the arrow bends.
rules.r3: Each series has 5 shots; the ball position, the wall and the keeper's movement change every shot.
